symptom: Director Task 3 created README.md plus two Rust test files with committed effect receipts, then materialization semantic quality failed because README anti-placeholder prose was classified as unfinished scaffold content.
root_cause: The placeholder detector distinguished comments, strings, attributes, and code tokens but treated all documentation prose as executable scaffold evidence. Explicit negation such as 'rather than a static placeholder' therefore produced a false quality failure. Coverage then matched a cleanup rule but produced no plan, suppressing the Director LLM fallback and terminalizing an otherwise substantive task.

fix.policy: Only documentation suffixes may suppress placeholder matches, and only when a bounded same-sentence prefix proves explicit negation such as rather than, instead of, not, never, without, avoid, reject, or forbid. Executable code and affirmative README placeholders remain rejected.

verification.tdd_red: Negated README case failed while affirmative placeholder case passed before implementation.
verification.negative_case: README text 'This section is a placeholder until ...' remains rejected.

automatic_audit_rule: When materialization quality reports a bare placeholder marker, capture the exact matching line and file type. Documentation-only explicit negation is not unfinished content; code identifiers and affirmative prose remain blocking.
next_action: Use same-workspace stage-local recovery after loading the fixed Polaris source. Preserve PM/CE authority and successful Director Task 1/2 receipts; rerun only failed Director Task 3 or the failed quality verifier.
